title: Emio – The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club
synopsis: The first new Famicom Detective Club in 27 years — retained as Nintendo’s Nintendo Switch game card.

curatorNotes:
Emio – The Smiling Man opens with a schoolboy found dead, a paper bag with a smiling face over his head — echoing an unsolved string of murders eighteen years earlier and the urban legend of the Smiling Man. Yoshio Sakamoto wrote and produced it.

It was the first new Famicom Detective Club game in 27 years, following MAGES.’ 2021 remakes of the two Famicom originals, and released worldwide on August 29, 2024.

This filing opens the Famicom Detective Club lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Nintendo’s retail edition of Emio – The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released worldwide on August 29, 2024 (HAC-P-A7LQA). A Collector’s Edition was issued in Japan.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Nintendo, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
